reason: A local Markdown knowledge-management plugin that builds dual knowledge graphs and provides ranked retrieval, linked reading paths, note access, feedback, and index diagnostics for DSH and Claude Code.

summaries.zh: 将本地 Markdown 笔记构建为带关联和衰减权重的知识图谱，并为 DSH 与 Claude Code 提供排序检索、阅读路径、笔记读取和反馈工具。
summaries.en: Builds knowledge graphs from local Markdown notes and provides DSH and Claude Code with ranked retrieval, reading paths, note access, feedback, and index diagnostics.

capabilities: Reads Markdown notes from a configured local vault
Builds and maintains local knowledge-graph and retrieval indexes
Provides ranked, linked note retrieval with reading paths
Reads individual note contents through a read-only tool
Records explicit retrieval feedback and reports index health
